title: Online trivial cubic quotient
objective: Implement a general source-transparent native early exit for theorem-complete complex cubic factor bases by collecting useful adjacent relations incrementally, updating the exact relation lattice online, and publishing a replay-authenticated trivial class group immediately when the quotient has index one, while preserving all nontrivial and exact fallback paths

oracles: authenticated Sage.js transcript and independent exact replay
PARI bnfinit(P,0) class-group invariants under matching GRH assumptions

handoff.summary: The closed source-transparent cubic program now preserves PARI's useful-ideal permutation and visits it backward, constructs reduced adjacent-ideal plans just in time, admits exact principal relations incrementally, and maintains an exact resident row-HNF until it proves the theorem-complete quotient is Z^n. It then publishes a trivial presentation without unit reconstruction or analytic certification; final HNF/SNF publication and independent ordinary-object transcript replay remain authoritative. LMFDB 3.1.10636.1 shrinks from the frozen 32-row/all-seven-plan transcript to 11 rows after planning two ideals and enumerating 17 candidates. Three permanent frozen holdouts, a separate 25-field holdout sweep (10 trivial and 15 nontrivial), nontrivial controls, and an effort-7 C42 path all agree exactly and replay.
risks: The complete architecture:check and test:changed runners stop at the integration-owned optimizer-opportunity manifest because this mathematical source change invalidates its recorded input digest; all preceding architecture checks and the full inherited build pass, and this lane intentionally does not claim or regenerate the shared evidence artifact.

The complete test:native run reached its final combined group with 79 passes, one skip, and two failures caused by the now-removed dead helper and its stale production inventory expectation. The focused production-pack test is rerun after that fix; the entire 14-minute umbrella command is left as a failed historical receipt rather than repeated.

Only linux-x64 was executable in this lane; the source-transparent closure has no architecture-specific branch, but the required Linux arm64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64 gates remain release/integration responsibilities.
next_steps: Regenerate the shared optimizer-opportunity artifacts after integration and rerun the complete architecture:check/test:changed chain.
Measure the integrated target and expanded trivial corpus on the reserved opt timing VM; this lane deliberately did not use opt.
Use the authenticated planned/enumerated/retained diagnostics to select the next slow structural cubic regime rather than tuning the exact fallback.
